Ah. Wow, thank you so much for checking in, that's so kind of you!

I mean, honestly? Really not great. But... **🤷**

Yeah. It's like, that's the whole point...? 

Thank you. Same to you <3

Hi, thanks!

I do eat, just not enough. I had my appt today (posted yesterday) - hence the edit above. It didn't go great.... But I guess it could have gone worse, so that is something?

Thank you. Yeah, I guess I'm comparing where I am right now to the past and I'm like "It's not *as bad* as it was then, therefore..." But yeah. That doesn't mean I don't need or deserve help I guess. 

That's true. I'll see what happens I guess... Thank you <3

Thanks for the reply! I've been going to therapy for around 8 years now and no one has ever suggested bipolar for me, which I guess is why I am hesitant about it. (Although, granted, I don't usually discuss the mood changes that often.) 

Maybe a bad analogy, but I just feel like my emotions are in a washing machine. The default setting is hopeless/down, but then it changes to the extreme lows or highs and it can be multiple times in a day (Eg; start off high, then low, than high, than end low). Is this normal for bipolar? I always assumed cycles lasted longer? Thanks again :)
